preconditions.name: H1::zworld_world_encoder_trained
preconditions.description: P0 warmup moved at least one split_encoder.world_encoder tensor, i.e. z_world is a prediction-trained encoder rather than a frozen random projection
preconditions.control: the P0 warmup itself, on the arm's own training env at the arm's own p0 episode count -- the phase whose stated job is to train the world model

preconditions.name: H1::zworld_encodes_exogenous_change
preconditions.description: bare ||z_obs - z_prev|| AUROC for hazard-moved vs not, STAY stratum, pre- AND post-shift
preconditions.control: positive control -- agent cannot have caused the change

preconditions.name: H1::move_ok_confound_absent
preconditions.description: bare ||z_obs - z_prev|| AUROC in MOVE_OK near chance, pre- AND post-shift
preconditions.control: negative control

preconditions.name: H1::causal_class_events_sufficient
preconditions.description: min(n_drift, n_no_drift) in the POST-shift held-out MOVE_OK stratum (the scoring set)
preconditions.control: the exact precondition V3-EXQ-783 failed on

preconditions.name: H1::e2world_action_pathway_live
preconditions.description: mean ||f(z,a_i) - f(z,a_j)|| AT INITIALISATION (PRE_BASE; SCRATCH cells share this init)
preconditions.control: wiring check, before any training

preconditions.name: H1::action_map_genuinely_rewired
preconditions.description: count of the 4 movement actions whose post-shift displacement differs from canonical (a derangement has no fixed point)
preconditions.control: sanity check that the derangement is not an accidental no-op, verified per seed

preconditions.name: H1::surface_statistics_preserved
preconditions.description: max |pre-shift frac - post-shift frac| over STAY / MOVE_OK / MOVE_BLOCKED / drift-event fractions
preconditions.control: the load-bearing design claim: a permutation of interchangeable movement actions under a uniform policy holds these marginals fixed in expectation

preconditions.name: H1::pre_base_in_distribution_signature
preconditions.description: PRE_BASE comparator informative in-distribution: mean gap-vs-chance AND mean gap-vs-bare each >= max(0.050, sd)
preconditions.control: mirrors 995's C1+C2 on PRE_BASE; a failing in-distribution fit makes any post-shift reading uninterpretable

preconditions.name: H1::shift_degrades_frozen_forward_fit
preconditions.description: frozen model's post-shift held-out forward MSE minus its own PRE_BASE held-out forward MSE -- positive in every seed (the manipulation reached the DV)
preconditions.control: manipulation-check, not a claim criterion

preconditions.name: H1::readapt_does_not_regress_frozen_fit
preconditions.description: READAPT@B0 held-out forward MSE improvement over FROZEN minus max(1e-05, 5% of the shift-induced degradation) -- positive in every seed
preconditions.control: readapt-budget non-vacuity check (1001's gate, same budget)

preconditions.name: H1::scratch_control_trained
preconditions.description: SCRATCH@B0 held-out forward MSE at THIS cell's entry weights (measured on the same model object before its first optimizer step; red-team F6) minus after the 120-step budget -- positive in every seed (the control is not a no-op)
preconditions.control: positive control on the H1 discriminator itself

preconditions.name: H1::partial_control_trained
preconditions.description: PARTIAL@B0 held-out forward MSE at THIS cell's entry weights (measured on the same model object before its first optimizer step; red-team F6) minus after the 120-step budget -- positive in every seed (the control is not a no-op)
preconditions.control: positive control on the H1 discriminator itself

preconditions.name: H1::scratch_entry_is_shared_init
preconditions.description: count of seeds whose SCRATCH@B0 entry_state_hash equals the seed's recorded init_state_hash (the weights PRE_BASE was trained from)
preconditions.control: identity recorded, not inferred from RNG order

preconditions.name: H1::shuffle_draw_se_resolves_floor
preconditions.description: standard error of the 5-draw shuffled-action AUROC mean at B0 (worst of the three starts) must be <= TRANSFER_ABS_FLOOR so the H1 floor is resolvable; draws are PAIRED across cells within a seed (same permutations), so this is conservative for T (red-team F8)
preconditions.control: instrument precision on the DV's own control term
